boundaries.startup: Popen to owned mapped window, usable visible editor Save, real XTest Tab focus roundtrip and completed PNG capture; includes AT-SPI polling and screenshot observer overhead.
boundaries.first_start: One new process on a fresh SQLite backup, initialization/migration may be included; OS cache uncontrolled.
boundaries.repeated_startup: n new processes on the same initialized backup; OS pages warm/uncontrolled, accessibility session initialized. Process-cold, not physical/cache-cold.
boundaries.core_search: Pre-discovery of search/list excluded. Real XTest Ctrl+A and ASCII keys to exact current ID label, then native Tab to focused, visible, sensitive Edit action. Includes debounce, rendering,5ms AT-SPI polling and result-focus navigation; no pure UI latency claim. Correct-visible-action boundary is recorded separately.
boundaries.preview: Real XTest Space on already-discovered focused preview button to enabled post button, after source reason mutation invalidates old verification. Includes accessibility polling; n=1.
boundaries.post: Real XTest Space on already-discovered focused post button to committed SQLite payload containing one opening and one journal; includes durable database observer polling; n=1.
boundaries.rss: Application-only /proc/PID/status KiB; startup sampled every10ms and steady after500ms idle. After-workflow separate point after posting. Helpers excluded.

limits: No OS cache flush, physical SSD evidence, dedicated reference hardware, Windows or Wayland claim.
Virtual shared executor scheduling and font/library cache state are uncontrolled; hashing and backup warm file pages.
Native forms fixture is distinct from the35-row CSV fixture. No CSV import claim when import_source is absent.
n10/n20 nearest-rank p99 equals worst; n1 preview/post and workflow memory are not tail estimates.
